Method 1: Simplify Bracket First (BODMAS): 1) Middle bracket: $1 + \frac{3}{8} = \frac{11}{8}$, so reciprocal $= \frac{8}{11}$.
2) Expression $= \frac{5}{2} - \frac{5}{3} + \frac{8}{11} = \frac{5}{6} + \frac{8}{11} = \mathbf{\frac{103}{66}}$.

Method 2: Reciprocal + Outer Pair First (8 sec): Group $\left(\frac{5}{2} - \frac{5}{3}\right) = \frac{5}{6}$, then cross-multiply $+ \frac{8}{11}$ = $\mathbf{\frac{103}{66}}$!

subject: Mathematics
topic: Quantitative Aptitude • RRB NTPC UG 2024 (01 Sep 2025 Shift 1)

question.en: Simplify: $3\left(\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)x^2 - 24x + 18\right) - 4(x^2 + 7x - 18)$
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित को सरल कीजिए:
$3\left(\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)x^2 - 24x + 18\right) - 4(x^2 + 7x - 18)$

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**−100x + 126**).
solution.keyConcept: x² Term Cancellation + Sign Trap on −(−d)

optionTrick.en: Since $x^2$ terms cancel ($4x^2 - 4x^2 = 0$), check signs directly: $x$ term $= -72 - 28 = -100x$ (negative!) and constant $= +54 + 72 = +126$ (**positive!**). Sign pair `(−, +)` uniquely locks Option B!
optionTrick.hi: $x^2$ पद कटते हैं; $x$ गुणांक ऋणात्मक ($-100x$) व अचर पद धनात्मक ($+126$) होना तुरंत `(−, +)` चिह्न वाला विकल्प B पक्का करता है!

trapAlert.en: Beware double negative at the end: $-4 \times (-18) = +72$ (NOT $-72$!).
trapAlert.hi: अंतिम पद का चिह्न जाल: $-4 \times (-18) = +72$ (धनात्मक!) होता है।

steps.en:
1) Expand first bracket: $4x^2 - 72x + 54$.
2) Expand second bracket: $-4x^2 - 28x + 72$.
3) Combine like terms: $(4 - 4)x^2 + (-72 - 28)x + (54 + 72) = \mathbf{-100x + 126}$.

title.en: Method 2: Put x = 0 & Sign Check (5 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: x = 0 व चिह्न नियम ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Full Bracket Expansion: 1) Expand first bracket: $4x^2 - 72x + 54$.
2) Expand second bracket: $-4x^2 - 28x + 72$.
3) Combine like terms: $(4 - 4)x^2 + (-72 - 28)x + (54 + 72) = \mathbf{-100x + 126}$.

Method 2: Put x = 0 & Sign Check (5 sec): Put $x = 0$: $3(18) - 4(-18) = 54 + 72 = +126$. Since both $x$ terms are negative ($-72x - 28x$), only `−100x + 126` has `(−x, +126)`!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: पूर्ण कोष्ठक विस्तार विधि: 1) पहला कोष्ठक: $4x^2 - 72x + 54$।
2) दूसरा कोष्ठक: $-4x^2 - 28x + 72$।
3) सजातीय पद मिलाने पर $= \mathbf{-100x + 126}$।

विधि 2: x = 0 व चिह्न नियम ट्रिक: $x = 0$ रखने पर अचर $= +54 + 72 = +126$ व दोनों $x$-पद ऋणात्मक ($-72x - 28x = -100x$) $\Rightarrow$ तुरंत **−100x + 126**!
